name: Rahat Sayyed
summary: Full-stack engineer with 3+ years of commercial React and TypeScript experience, building applications from scratch with contract-driven APIs on Node.js and deploying on AWS EC2. Cut initial load time by 11 seconds through a system-wide React state management refactor, and reduced development build time by ~10 minutes per cycle by optimizing a Docker-based pipeline. Work directly with frontend, backend and AI teams, and communicate in English daily on architecture decisions and trade-offs.

experience.title: Software Engineer
description: Directed a system-wide refactor of React state management, eliminating 9+ redundant API calls and reducing initial load time by 11 seconds.
Designed multi-policy schemas and contract-driven TypeScript APIs, reducing integration-related regressions by 70% as AI interfaces evolved.
Led the architecture and implementation of a modular, policy-driven governance layer centralizing MCP access control and model I/O auditing, reducing policy misconfiguration issues by ~50%.

Developed role-based authentication and onboarding in Next.js with tenant-level access boundaries, eliminating post-login misrouting and reducing user-reported login errors by 30% within the first month post release.
Optimized Docker-based frontend build pipeline on AWS EC2 by restructuring dependency installation and leveraging layer caching, reducing development build times by ~10 minutes.
Built a unified violations ingestion pipeline across LLM, MCP and RAG flows and D3-based risk analytics dashboards, reducing incident investigation time by approximately 40%.
Coordinated frontend, backend and AI teams to integrate 3+ evolving model capabilities under governance constraints.
